metadata.title: May 9, 2014 - To a T
metadata.author: by Judith Seretto / Edited by Mike Shenk

entries.clue: Comic book queen of the jungle
Possible assignment for a forest ranger?
Result of settling a lawsuit with a tech company?
Quality assurance from a British noble?
Supplement taken around the start of spring, in a yearly supply?
Snow White, Cinderella and Ariel, none of them clergy?
Lack of vagueness when deciding who's naughty or nice?
Where Colonel Sanders spent much time primping?
Its flag features a curved dagger
Accessory for a mollusk strip show?
City at the mouth of the Yodo River
